name: awesome-collision-detection
desc: :sunglasses: A curated list of awesome collision detection libraries and resources

resources.name: ODE
resources.desc: Open Dynamics Engine with rigid body simulation and collision detection. [bitbucket]

resources.name: ncollide
resources.desc: Rust collision detection library for 2D and 3D geometric queries. ⭐ 925 · last commit 2022

resources.name: libccd
resources.desc: Small C library for collision detection between convex shapes using GJK and EPA. ⭐ 652 · last commit 2018

resources.name: BEPUphysics 1
resources.desc: Pure C# physics engine with broadphase and narrowphase collision detection. ⭐ 434 · last commit 2021

resources.name: CCD-Wrapper
resources.desc: Wrapper and benchmark for continuous collision detection algorithms. ⭐ 61 · last commit 2022

resources.name: JitterPhysics
resources.desc: C# rigid body physics engine with collision detection support. ⭐ 47 · last commit 2021

resources.name: GIMPACT
resources.desc: Tools for geometry processing and collision detection.

resources.name: SOLID
resources.desc: Collision detection of 3D objects undergoing rigid motion and deformation.

resources.name: bounding-mesh
resources.desc: Implementation of the bounding mesh and bounding convex decomposition algorithms for single-sided mesh approximation. ⭐ 351 · last commit 2019

resources.name: spatial-collision-datastructures
resources.desc: Benchmark of various spatial data structures for collision detection.
